sources.entry: Lyrimuse - Word-synced desktop lyrics for Apple Music, Spotify, QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Kugou and YouTube Music / Spotify Web in the browser. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Yudaotor/lyrimuse) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

Lyrimuse - Word-synced desktop lyrics for Apple Music, Spotify, QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Kugou and YouTube Music / Spotify Web in the browser, with translation, romanization and Last.fm scrobbling.

summary.one_liner: Lyrimuse is an open-source macOS menu-bar app that shows word-by-word synced desktop lyrics for music from many players, with translation, romanization and Last.fm scrobbling.
summary.what_it_does: Lyrimuse runs in the macOS menu bar and highlights lyrics word by word as a song plays, shown as a floating always-on-top overlay, menu bar text, a Dynamic-Island-style capsule under the notch, the Touch Bar, or a full Apple-Music-style lyrics window. It reads playback from eleven players, including Apple Music, Spotify, QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Kugou, KKBOX, Amazon Music and the Kaset YouTube Music app, plus YouTube Music and Spotify Web in the browser once paired. It searches fourteen lyrics sources, scores candidates, and can add translation and romanization (Jyutping, pinyin, and per-line readings). It also keeps a Last.fm listening profile, scrobbles plays, and optionally sends to ListenBrainz, Discord status, a public now-playing page and push digests.
use_cases: show synced lyrics on the Mac desktop while listening
word-by-word karaoke lyrics for Apple Music or Spotify
show lyrics in the macOS menu bar
scrobble Apple Music or Spotify plays to Last.fm
add translation or romanization to song lyrics
show lyrics for YouTube Music or Spotify Web in a browser
how_to_run: Alternatively, download the release zip or dmg from the Releases page and move Lyrimuse.app to /Applications
Build from source: clone the repo, cd lyrimuse/lyrimuse, run ./build.sh (requires Xcode Command Line Tools and Go)
notable: Word-by-word highlighting across fourteen lyrics sources, with automatic best-match scoring and manual search showing scores
Eleven supported players, including Chinese-language players, KKBOX, Amazon Music and Kaset, plus browser players via pairing
On-device translation through Apple's Translation framework, with per-line romanization including Cantonese Jyutping
Last.fm and ListenBrainz scrobbling with a full listening profile, heatmap and stats
Exposes lyrimuse:// links for Shortcuts, Raycast or Alfred
caveats: Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later; Intel support via a separate universal build
Releases are signed with the project's own certificate, not an Apple Developer ID, so Gatekeeper must be cleared once manually or via Homebrew

Several players (QQ Music, NetEase, Kugou, Soda Music, KKBOX, Amazon Music, LX Music, Spotify, Kaset) need the ungive/media-control dependency for source builds; some features need Automation or Accessibility permissions
Apple Music lyrics require a subscription; the Mac App Store does not distribute the app
